Regular meeting of the City Council
Austin Texas July 17, 1882
R Peak acting Mayor Presiding

Roll call present Aldermen Keeney Schuber Bruggerhoff, Kauppertz, Moeller
Absent Aldermen Cook Radkey, Wilson Metz

On motion of Alderman Schuber the Council was called and the Marshall sent after the
absentees

On motion of Alderman Bruggerhoff the
Call of the Council was suspended

Motion to adjourn was lost

A fine of one dollar was entered against
Aldermen Metz Cook Radkey and Wilson
for non attendance at this meeting.

On motion the Council adjourned
Aug 7th 1882 Read and approved Aug 7th 1882 T. E. Powell
City Clerk
